issue.title: Gradle tasks are failed on Windows

labels.name: triage/duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
It isn't possible to build and launch application with latest Quarkus versions (1.1.0.CR1, 999-SNAPSHOT). Based on error messages I think the issue only appears on Windows.

**Expected behavior**
`quarkusBuild` and `quarkusDev` tasks are executed without errors.

**Actual behavior**
`quarkusBuild`:
```
Execution failed for task ':quarkusBuild'.
> Illegal char <:> at index 65: D:\dev\_projects\quarkus-bug-reproducer\build\classes\java\main;D:\dev\_projects\quarkus-bug-reproducer\build\classes\kotlin\main
```

`quarkusDev`:
```
Some problems were found with the configuration of task ':quarkusDev' (type 'QuarkusDev').
> Directory 'D:\dev\_projects\quarkus-bug-reproducer\build\classes\java\main;D:\dev\_projects\quarkus-bug-reproducer\build\classes\kotlin\main' specified for property 'workingDir' does not exist.
> Directory 'D:\dev\_projects\quarkus-bug-reproducer\src\main\java;D:\dev\_projects\quarkus-bug-reproducer\src\main\kotlin' specified for property 'sourceDir' does not exist.
```

**To Reproduce**
1. Clone https://github.com/rkudryashov/quarkus-bug-reproducer
2. Run `quarkusBuild` or `quarkusDev`

**Environment:**
- Microsoft Windows 10
- openjdk version "13"
- Quarkus version: any of [1.1.0.CR1, 999-SNAPSHOT]

body: How can we build until the release 1.2.0 will be published ? 😊

Downgrade to 1.0.0.Final until the next release comes up.

>
FWIW I’m thinking about releasing a 1.1.1 at the beginning of next year.

When I downgrade to `1.0.0.Final` I have the same issue as this one #5781.
```
Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Unable to find quarkus-gradle-plugin dependency
        at io.quarkus.gradle.tasks.QuarkusDev.lambda$addGradlePluginDeps$2(QuarkusDev.java:403)
        at io.quarkus.gradle.tasks.QuarkusDev.addGradlePluginDeps(QuarkusDev.java:403)
        at io.quarkus.gradle.tasks.QuarkusDev.startDev(QuarkusDev.java:256)
        ... 95 more

```

That's because the Gradle config changed. Check the Migration guide for
more details
